description: One-country roll-up: a summary plus the available visa, citizenship, tax, banking, property-tax, cost-of-living, safety, healthcare, passport, expat-index and blacklist data. Pass topics to limit the response because a full profile can be large. Use compare_countries for the same topic across countries, or get_program for one immigration program's complete sourced record.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

topics.description: Only return these topics. Omit for the full profile.

name: get_country_profile
title: Country profile
